retrievalProfile.description: A centered medium close-up portrait of a male artist with layered blonde hair against a blurred rocky backdrop, featuring bold glowing sans-serif typography at the bottom.

recipe.visualDefinition: A warm-toned, shallow depth-of-field portrait of a man with feathered, highlighted hair wearing a tan suede shirt, positioned against a soft-focus desert rock formation with integrated glowing text overlays.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered and occupying the upper two-thirds of the frame
Warm tan and beige tones in clothing and background harmonizing with skin tones
Typography anchored to the lower third, overlapping the subject's chest
Soft, diffused natural lighting creating gentle shadows on the face
coreInvariants: Shallow depth of field blurring the rocky background
Outer glow effect on the primary display typography
Warm, earthy color palette dominated by ochre and sand

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered medium close-up, head and shoulders filling the frame vertically.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and the bright, glowing primary text at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the subject's eyes down to the bold primary name, then to the smaller subtitle below.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the subject and background textures fill the entire square format.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm beige and tan (clothing and background)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low to medium saturation with high value in the highlights of the hair and text.
paletteRestrictions: No neon or primary colors except for eye detail

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Same family or similar geometric sans-serifs with contrasting scale and color.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric, wide, and modern feel of the primary text.
Provides a similar open counter and clean geometric structure.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a medium close-up portrait of a man with layered, highlighted blonde hair and blue eyes, wearing a tan suede shirt, against a blurred desert rock background with warm natural lighting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add bold, wide, uppercase geometric sans-serif text in the lower third with a soft yellow outer glow. Place a smaller, dark brown subtitle with wide tracking directly underneath.

verificationChecks: Is the text centered and glowing?
Is the background sufficiently blurred to create depth?
Is the color palette consistently warm and earthy?
Does the primary text overlap the subject's chest area?

adjustableVariables: Specific shade of the suede shirt
mustRedesign: Do not use specific artist names or album titles
Do not replicate specific brand logos

mustAchieve: Clean, legible typography with integrated glow

postGenerationChecks: Check that the glow does not obscure the letterforms
Ensure the subject's eyes are in sharp focus
Verify the tracking on the subtitle is wider than the primary text
recipe.reuseFormula: Warm-toned male portrait + blurred rocky background + glowing wide sans-serif typography.
